description: This PHP source file contains the implementation of the function 'display_field_lines', which generates HTML and JavaScript code to render and manipulate field lines within the SuiteCRM module AOR_Fields, particularly in the context of editing view. It includes logic for language loading, dynamic script inclusion, and database interaction to fetch related field data.

methods.name: display_field_lines
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript for displaying and editing field lines in the SuiteCRM module 'AOR_Fields'. It loads language files, scripts, and initializes related data for the editing view, incorporating database queries to fetch existing field configurations.
